text:
Maya (product): Heads up — I'm prototyping an 'Invocation Mosaic' tile for the Cost Dashboard to show per-invocation economics (tokens split, model used, cache hits, estimated cache savings). Want to align on telemetry & API shape before we lock UI.
Sam R (eng): +1. Do we have the raw per-invocation token split today? prompt vs completion vs cached prefix? Also worried about backend perf if we surface every field.
Joel K (platform): We emit token_counts and cache_hit flags, but not a clean split for cached vs prompted tokens when prefetch/merged chains happen. Also we lose model variant info on fallbacks.
Asha (design): For the tile, product wants a small sparkline and a stacked bar (prompt/completion/cached) per invocation + a popover with full JSON example and a "show example prompt" link. Need an API that returns a small summary per invocation and an optional full payload.
econ-bot: FYI: currently we store sampled full-invocation traces at 1%. Full_emit increases storage ~10x and query latency.
Maya (product): Proposed endpoint: GET /v1/invocations/econ?start=...&end=...&expand=cache,models&sample_rate=1%
Maya (product): example curl + minimal response:
```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invocations/econ?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-14&expand=cache,models" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
```json
[
  {
    "invocation_id": "inv_01F...",
    "timestamp": "2026-03-12T14:23:01Z",
    "model": "redwood-v2-3B",
    "model_variant": "quantized-v1",
    "tokens_prompt": "18",
    "tokens_completion": "62",
    "tokens_cached": "10",
    "cache_hit": "true",
    "estimated_cost_usd": "0.0024",
    "estimated_cache_savings_usd": "0.0007"
  }
]
```
Sam R (eng): That shape looks fine. Two engineering concerns: 1) computing estimated_cache_savings requires joined time-series (cache footprint vs effective token reduction) — can be heavy for large windows. 2) model_variant tracking needs router to attach chosen_variant_id to telemetry on every path.
Joel K (platform): On (1) we can pre-aggregate per-batcher the "avoided_tokens" metric and store it hourly; then the API pulls aggregates for dashboard tiles and only fetches sampled raw traces for the popover. This keeps the tile fast.
Asha (design): Sounds good. We should expose both "tile_summary" (pre-agg) and "example_trace" (sampled full). UI will default to summary and lazy-load example_trace on click.
Maya (product): UX ask: show an "amortized cache credit" column and a toggle to view credits as tenant-apportioned vs global-amortized.
Sam R (eng): Apportionment logic needs rules: per-tenant prefetched slabs vs shared slabs. I suggest: if slab is tenant-scoped, credit fully; if shared, amortize proportional to detected usage over the billing window.
Joel K (platform): Agree. We'll add a flag in the slab metadata: "scope": "tenant|shared" and a slab_id on the invocation. Attribution pipeline then joins invocations -> slab_id -> slab_scope -> allocate credits.
Asha (design): Also ask: can we show an "estimated impact if caching disabled" column (i.e., worst-case cost)? That helps product teams prioritize cache tuning.
Maya (product): Yes — useful. We can compute: estimated_cost_no_cache = estimated_cost_usd + estimated_cache_savings_usd and show delta.
econ-bot: Note: projected columns added will increase cardinality of the pre-agg table. Consider sampling or downsampling high-cardinality tenants.
Sam R (eng): Action items I see: 1) platform: attach model_variant and slab_id in router telemetry (Joel will own). 2) infra: create hourly pre-agg job for avoided_tokens & estimated_cache_savings (Sam will prototype). 3) product/design: final UI spec for tile + popover (Maya/Asha).
Joel K (platform): I'll add variant_id and slab_id to the telemetry proto by EOD, will tag RFC in #eng-platform for review.
Maya (product): Thanks — can we aim for an initial alpha (1% sample + tile based on pre-agg) next week? :eyes:
Asha (design): I'll upload the mock to Figma and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:
Sam R (eng): Quick note: We should add a rate-limit on the expand=cache param so dashboard queries don't explode. Suggest per-token points cost quota for the endpoint.
Maya (product): Good call. Add that to the RFC.
Joel K (platform): Cool. I'll post the RFC and include example SQL for the hourly pre-agg.
Maya (product): Thanks everyone — will follow up after RFC. :raised_hands:
